meta.description: Evidence on the durability of NVIDIA's software position, and comparative R&D.

cudaDevelopers.definitionalWarning: The figures below are NOT a consistent metric. 'Registered developers in the NVIDIA Developer Program' (2020), 'CUDA developers' (2023, 2024) and 'developers who have used CUDA since 2006' (2025) are three different things. NVIDIA has never published a methodology. Treat the series as directional evidence of ecosystem scale, not as a precise time series.

rAndD.definitionalWarning: Fiscal years are NOT aligned. NVIDIA's fiscal year N ends in January of calendar year N, so NVIDIA FY2026 (ended 25 Jan 2026) overlaps mostly with calendar 2025, which is the correct comparison against AMD FY2025 and Intel FY2025. The table below aligns on that basis. All figures are 'reported' from SEC 10-K filings via the XBRL ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense concept.
